descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Roche Diagnostics International Ltd in Rotkreuz is one of the world’s leading providers of diagnostic system solutions for clinics, laboratories and doctors’ offices. The company employs nearly 3000 people in Rotkreuz and is one of Roche Diagnostics’ main sites. The Opportunity
• Support the Systems Engineering team with process optimization for medical device development
• Create and develop use cases of AI for design analysis, system performance, and documentation
• Contribution to department specific tasks (maintenance of product specific records, such as requirements or risks using a Lifecycle Management tool (RETINA from codebeamer)
• Collaborate in interdisciplinary development teams
• Status reporting to the respective stakeholder according to project specific requirements Who You are:
• You are currently enrolled in a Bachelor's or Master's degree program or have recently graduated (within the last 12 months prior to the start date) in one of the following fields: biomedical, electrical or mechanical engineering, systems engineering, biotechnology, chemistry, etc.
• You are interested in new technologies, such as Artificial Intelligence
• You are excited to start your professional career in the medical diagnostics industry
• You should have the ability to communicate clearly with different target groups
• You are motivated to build, manage and foster relationships and networks
• Quick grasp and understanding of complex issues, conceptual and creative thinking
• You have good knowledge of spoken and written English, German is a plus Application process:
• Please upload a current CV, a copy of your diploma certificate, an enrollment certificate, and a motivation letter indicating your preferred start date for the internship.
• Please note, due to regulations, non-EU/EFTA citizens must provide a certificate from the university stating that an internship is mandatory as part of the application documents, and must be continuously enrolled in their university for the whole duration of this internship. If you are eager to contribute and feel you have the dedication to teamwork and innovation that we are seeking, then Roche is the organization for you. Every role at Roche plays a part in making a difference to patients’ lives. If you want to work in a passionate team, make your mark & improve lives, apply now! Additional Information Start date: August 2026, or upon availability Workload: 100% Duration: 6-12 months Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact. Let’s build a healthier future, together. Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.
